title: Add credential state evaluation for present, partial, missing, manual, and unknown without storing secret values
summary: Let Hermes evaluate whether required credentials appear available without leaking secret values.
acceptanceCriteria: Credential state detects present, partial, missing, manual, and unknown states.
Secret values are never included in status payloads.
reviewNotes: Implemented credential_presence, credential_state, and tests proving secret values are not returned.
